name: Run Motor for Duration
prose: This block will run one or more motors clockwise or counterclockwise for a specified number of rotations, seconds, or degrees. The motor speed is set by the Set Speed Block. The default speed is 75%.

name: Motor Go to Position
prose: This block sets one or more motors to a speciﬁed position. The motor can be set to run clockwise, counterclockwise, or to take the shortest path to the specified position. The position ranges from 0 to 359 degrees. The motor speed is set by the Set Speed Block. The default speed is 75%.

name: Start Motor
prose: This block will run one or more motors clockwise or counterclockwise forever. The motor speed is set by the Set Speed Block. The default speed is 75%.

name: Stop Motor
prose: This block stops one or more motors from running. The motor will brake so that it quickly comes to a complete stop.

name: Set Motor Speed
prose: This block sets the speed of one or more motors. The speed range is -100 to 100. Negative values will reverse the direction of the motor. If the speed hasn't been specified, the default value is 75%.

name: Motor Position
prose: This block reports the current position of a motor. The position is given in degrees from 0 to 359.

name: Motor Speed
prose: This block reports the current speed of a motor. The value given is the motor's actual speed, not the speed set by the Set Speed Block.

name: Move for Duration
prose: This block moves a Driving Base either forward or backward for a specified number of centimeters, inches, seconds, degrees, or rotations. The distance that's moved in centimeters and inches depends on how the Driving Base has been built. Use the Set 1 Motor Rotation to Distance Moved Block to calibrate your Driving Base.

name: Start Moving
prose: This block starts moving a Driving Base either forward or backward.

name: Move with Steering for Duration
prose: This block moves a Driving Base forward for a certain duration with the possibility of steering. Higher steering values (i.e., +99 and -99) will make the arc path of the Driving Base sharper. Use a value of “0” to drive in a straight line. Using the values 100 and -100 will make the Driving Base pivot on itself.

name: Start Moving with Steering
prose: This block starts moving a Driving Base forward with the possibility of steering forever. Higher steering values (i.e., +99 and -99) will make the arc path of the Driving Base sharper. Use a value of “0” to drive in a straight line. Using the values 100 and -100 will make the Driving Base pivot on itself.

name: Stop Moving
prose: This block stops all movement of a Driving Base by braking the motors.

name: Set Movement Speed
prose: This block sets the speed of a moving Driving Base. The speed range is -100 to 100. Negative values change the direction of the movement. The default value is 50%.

name: Set Movement Motors
prose: This block defines the Ports to which the 2 driving motors are connected.

name: Set 1 Motor Rotation to Distance Moved
prose: This block calibrates the distance of a Driving Base so that the distance unit (i.e., centimeters/inches) specified in the Movement Blocks will be accurate.

name: Turn On 5x5 Light Matrix for Seconds
prose: This block creates a pattern and makes it light up on the 5x5 light matrix for a specified length of time. The Block will turn the pixels off when the time is up.

name: Turn On 5x5 Light Matrix
prose: This block creates a pattern and makes it light up on the 5x5 light matrix. The pattern stays lit up until the light matrix is told to do something else or the program is stopped.

name: Write on 5x5 Light Matrix
prose: This block displays a text string on the 5x5 light matrix by scrolling one letter at a time over the display.

name: Turn off 5x5 Light Matrix
prose: This block turns off all the lights on the 5x5 light matrix.

name: Set 5x5 Light Matrix Brightness
prose: This block sets the brightness of the 5x5 light matrix for the next block in the programming stack that will use the light matrix, such as the Turn On 5x5 Matrix Block. If the brightness has not been specified, the default value is 100%.

name: Set Pixel Brightness on 5x5 Light Matrix
prose: This block sets the brightness of an individual pixel on the 5x5 light matrix. Only the specified pixel is updated. The rest of the light matrix remains unchanged.

name: Rotate Orientation of 5x5 Light Matrix
prose: This block rotates the orientation of what's being shown on the 5x5 Light Matrix either clockwise or counterclockwise.

name: Set Orientation of 5x5 Light Matrix
prose: This block sets the orientation of what's being shown on the 5x5 light matrix. The orientation can be set to upright, upside down, left, or right. The default orientation is upright.

name: Turn On 3x3 Color Matrix for Seconds
prose: This block creates a pattern and makes it light up on the 3x3 color matrix for a specified length of time. The Block will turn the pixels off when the time is up.

name: Turn On 3x3 Color Matrix
prose: This block creates a pattern and makes it light up on the 3x3 color matrix. The pattern stays lit up until the light matrix is told to do something else or the program is stopped.

name: Turn off 3x3 Color Matrix
prose: This block turns off all the lights on the 3x3 color matrix.

name: Set 3x3 Color Matrix Brightness
prose: This block sets the brightness of the 3x3 color matrix for the next block in the programming stack that will use the color matrix, such as the Turn On 3x3 Color Matrix Block. If the brightness has not been specified, the default value is 100%.

name: Set Pixel Brightness on 3x3 Color Matrix
prose: This block sets the color and brightness of an individual pixel on the 3x3 color matrix. Only the specified pixel is updated. The rest of the color matrix remains unchanged.

name: Rotate Orientation of 3x3 Color Matrix
prose: This block rotates the orientation of what's being shown on the 3x3 Color Matrix either clockwise or counterclockwise.

name: Set Orientation of 3x3 Color Matrix
prose: This block sets the orientation of what's being shown on the 3x3 color matrix. The orientation can be set to upright, upside down, left, or right. The default orientation is upright.

name: Set Center Button Light
prose: This block sets the color of the Center Button light.

name: Light up Distance Sensor
prose: This block turns the Distance Sensor lights on and off.

name: Play Sound until Done
prose: This block plays a selected sound on your device and pauses the programming stack until the sound is finished. Sounds can be added to the project using the Add Sound Button.

name: Start Sound
prose: This block starts playing a selected sound on your device and immediately plays the next block in the programming stack. Sounds can be added to the project using the Add Sound Button.

name: Play Beep for Seconds
prose: This block plays a beep tone on your Hub for a speciﬁed number of seconds.

name: Start Playing Beep
prose: This block plays a beep tone on your Hub. It'll keep playing until something in the program stops it.

name: Stop All Sounds
prose: This block stops all sounds that are currently playing (i.e., beeps and sound ﬁles).

name: Change Pitch Effect By
prose: This block changes the pitch or pan left/right effect of the sounds that are being played on the device. The pan effect determines which speaker is emitting the sound, with "-100" being only the left speaker, "0" being normal, and "100" being only the right speaker.

name: Set Pitch Effect By
prose: This block changes the pitch or pan left/right effect of the sounds that are being played on the device. The pan effect determines which speaker is emitting the sound, with "-100" being only the left speaker, "0" being normal, and "100" being only the right speaker.

name: Clear Sound Effects
prose: This block sets both the pitch and pan left/right sound effect back to normal.

name: Change Volume
prose: This block changes the volume of the sound currently being played by a specified increment from the volume at which it's currently playing. The default volume is 100%.

name: Set Volume
prose: This block sets the volume of the sound. The default volume is 100%.

name: Volume
prose: This block reports the current sound volume.

name: When Program Starts
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it, sequentially from top to bottom, when the program starts.

name: When Color Is
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the Color Sensor detects a speciﬁed color. The detectable colors are: (0) Black (1) Violet (3) Blue (4) Light Blue (6) Green (7) Yellow (9) Red (10) White (-1) no color This block will only trigger when it detects the speciﬁed color. This means that the block won't re-trigger if the detected color remains unchanged.

name: When Pressure Is
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the Force Sensor is pressed, hard-pressed, released, or when it detects any change in the pressure that's being applied. This block will only trigger at the speciﬁed event. This means that the block won't re-trigger if the pressure on the Force Sensor remains unchanged.

name: When Closer Than
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the Distance Sensor detects that an object is closer than or further than the specified distance. This block will only trigger at the speciﬁed event. This means that the block won't re-trigger if the distance remains unchanged.

name: When Tilted
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the Hub is tilted in the specified direction starting from a flat, button(s) up position. The block will only trigger at the event of the Hub being tilted. That means that it won't trigger again as long as the Hub isn't tilted in a new direction.

name: When Hub Orientation Is Up
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the Hub is placed in the specified orientation. The possible orientations are: (0) Top (1) Front (2) Right side (3) Bottom (4) Back (5) Left side This block will only trigger at the speciﬁed event. This means that the block won't re-trigger if the orientation of the Hub remains unchanged.

name: When Hub Shaken
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the Hub is: (1) Shaking (2) Tapped (3) FallingThis block will only trigger at the start of the speciﬁed event. This means that the block won't re-trigger if the movement of the Hub remains unchanged.

name: When Hub Button Pressed
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the Left or Right Buttons are pressed or released. This block will only trigger at the speciﬁed event. This means that the block won't re-trigger as long as the state of the Buttons remains unchanged.

name: When Timer
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when the timer gets above a specified value. The "timer" is a constantly running clock. It starts from "0" when the program starts. It can be reset using the Reset Timer Block.

name: When
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when a certain condition is true. This block will only trigger at the event of the specified condition becoming true. This means that the block won't re-trigger if the condition remains true.

name: When I Receive Message
prose: This block plays all of the blocks attached to it when a speciﬁed message is broadcasted by the Broadcast Message Block or the Broadcast Message and Wait Block.

name: Broadcast Message
prose: This block broadcasts a speciﬁed message. All of the When I Receive Message Hat Blocks that have been set to the specified message will play. After the message has been sent, the next block in the programming stack will play.

name: Broadcast Message and Wait
prose: This block broadcasts a speciﬁed message. All of the When I Receive Message Hat Blocks that have been set to the specified message will play. After the message has been sent, the block waits until all of the programming stacks with the specified message are ﬁnished before it proceeds to the next block in the stack.

name: Is color?
prose: This block returns “true” when the Color Sensor detects the speciﬁed color. The detectable colors are: (0) Black (1) Violet (3) Blue (4) Light Blue (6) Green (7) Yellow (9) Red (10) White (-1) No color

name: Color
prose: This block returns the current value of the color detected by the Color Sensor. The detectable colors are: (0) Black (1) Violet (3) Blue (4) Light Blue (6) Green (7) Yellow (9) Red (10) White (-1) No color

name: Pressure
prose: This block reports the current pressure being applied to the Force Sensor in newtons or as a percentage. The sensor can detect 2-10 newtons.

name: Distance
prose: This block reports the current distance the Distance Sensor is detecting in centimeters, inches, or as a percentage. The sensor's range is 0-200 centimeters or 0-78.74 inches.

name: Is Hub orientation?
prose: This block returns “true” when the Hub is placed in the specified orientation. The possible orientations are: (0) Top (1) Front (2) Right side (3) Bottom (4) Back (5) Left side

name: Is Shaking?
prose: This block returns “true” when the Hub is Force Sensor is either: (0) tapped (2) shaking (3) falling

name: Raw Color
prose: This block returns the raw red, green, or blue color reading from the Color Sensor. The color value range is 0-255.

name: Hub Orientation
prose: This block reports the current orientation of the Hub. The Hub can detect the following orientations: (0) Top (1) Front (2) Right side (3) Bottom (4) Back (5) Left side

name: Gesture
prose: This block reports the current gesture performed on the Hub. The Hub can detect the following gestures: (0) tapped (2) shaking (3) falling
